milestoneReveal_tagline: Our biggest update yet — packed with the features you asked for.
milestoneShowcase_closingBody:
Namaze umwaka wose nkora iyi nyandiko. Twizeye ko bizakugirira akamaro mu murimo wo kubwiriza.

Mu rukundo rwa kivandimwe,
milestoneHero_liquidGlass_description: Igishushanyo gishya hamwe na tab bar izunguruka, amakarita akonje, hamwe nibikoresho byihariye bifata umucyo. Amaherezo, iyo app iba iri mu rugo kuri telefoni yawe.
milestoneHero_progress_description: Isura nshya y'ukwezi, umwaka, n'ibihe byose, hamwe n'intambwe zisanzwe, gusenyuka kw'ibyiciro, amasaha y'ubuzima, na fireworks igihe urenze intego.
milestoneHero_contacts_description: A dedicated Contacts tab with fuzzy search, smart sort, stacked filters, and inline avatars. Find anyone in two taps.
milestoneHero_iCloudSync_description: Your reports, contacts, and plans sync seamlessly across all your devices through iCloud. Optional photo sync keeps avatars in step too. Supporter feature.
milestoneHero_iCloudSync_descriptionAndr: Raporo, abantu na gahunda byawe bihuzwa ku bikoresho byawe bya Android binyuze kuri Google Drive yawe. Guhuza amafoto ni ubushake kandi bituma n'amafoto y'umwirondoro ahuza. Ni ikiranga cy'abaterankunga.
milestoneHero_widgets_description: Porogaramu ya USU-Soft ikora amasaha y'ukwezi, amasaha n'amahugurwa y'igihe gito kuri ecran yawe y'urugo. Kanda kuri widget iyo ari yo yose kugirango usimbuke neza aho ukeneye kujya.
milestoneSecondary_onboardingFounder_des: Onboarding yubatswe kuva hasi kugera hejuru, hamwe n'inyandiko yihariye y'umuterankunga hamwe n'urutonde rw'intego zawe.
milestoneSecondary_fireworks_description: Beautiful celebrations the moment you cross a milestone or annual goal.
milestoneSecondary_avatars_description: Ongeraho ifoto cyangwa avatar ya emoji kuri buri contact, ukoresheje gukanda kugirango kwagure umureba wuzuye.
milestoneSecondary_sharing_description: Hand off a contact to another publisher with a secure universal link.
milestoneSecondary_missedConversations_d: A gentle home-screen nudge for follow-ups that slipped past — dismiss them once you've reached out.
milestoneSecondary_followUpRework_descri: Urupapuro rusobanutse rwa reschedule hamwe na chips zihuse, inzira ngufi yo gusura log, hamwe na tappable contact previews.
milestoneSecondary_recurring_description: Gahunda y'umunsi w'icyumweru n'icyumweru cy'ukwezi, hamwe n'ibisobanuro n'ibiciro by'ibicuruzwa.
milestoneSecondary_rollover_description: Iminota mike ikomeza mu kwezi gutaha, intoki cyangwa mu buryo bwikora.
milestoneSecondary_supporter_description: A little thank-you for those already supporting the app — exclusive perks like a custom accent color.
milestoneSecondary_appIcon_description: Abashyigikiye barashobora guhinduranya icon ya porogaramu ya ecran yo mu rugo kuri imwe mu mpinduka nyinshi.
milestoneSecondary_schedule_description: A focused calendar view of your day plans and repeating conversations.
milestoneSecondary_shaders_description: Ubuzima bwawe bw'umurimo mu buryo bumwe: izina, inshingano, igihe cyakorewe, n'imibare ishimishije.
milestoneSecondary_mapEmpty_description: A friendlier empty state and refined location prompts on first use.

1100.c2: Adding time from Time Reports screen now defaults the report to the selected month.
1100.c3: Fixes an issue exporting January service report.

1110.c2: Hahinduwe imiterere imwe n'imwe kugira ngo ikore neza muri ekara nini.
1110.c3: Adjusted the method of submitting Bug Reports and Feature Requests to Github.

1111.c1: Hongewemo i paji yo gutanga impano kubifuza gutanga impano. Reba mu igenamiterere.

1220.c2: Improved import & export screen to be visually clearer.
1220.c4: Occasionally notifies you to create a new backup. This is configurable in the settings.

1221.c2: Fixed an issue where editing a conversation would incorrectly navigate.
1221.c3: Other minor bug fixes and performance improvements.

1230.c2: Added 'Today' button to quickly navigate back to current month when viewing previous months or years.
1230.c3: Updated Special Pioneers to not have an annual goal by default.

1230.c5: Greatly improved Italian translations, thank you brother Giuseppe!

1250.c3: Updated various sections of time reports screen to have more information and easier navigation.
1250.c4: Resolved minor visual issues and other bugs.

1260.c3: Gahunda zisubiramo zasibwa n'ibizaba vuba cyangwa ibizaba vuba byose mu gihe kiri imbere.

1260.c5: You can now share your time directly with NW Publisher!

1270.c1: Added Timer! ⏱️ (Stopwatch). You can now start and stop a timer to track your time directly within the app.
1270.c2: Resolved crashing issue for some devices when navigating to the Contact Details screen.
1270.c4: Other minor bug fixes and improvements.

1280.c3: Update dependencies and add security updates.
1280.c2: Updated Portuguese translations, thank you brother Sérgio!
1280.c4: 📝 A little personal note: I have been very busy with congregation responsibilities and life recently. After my upcoming convention next week, things will return more back to normal. I will be working on many more updates in the coming weeks! Thank you for your patience and for choosing WitnessWork! ❤️

1290.c1: Added new schedule section to month summary screen which helps you keep track of your time pacing.
1290.c2: Kuri ekara y'ahabanza, hakozwe neza ikibazo cy'ibyiciro byakingirizaga ibindi kigakunda kuba kuri ekara ntoya.
1290.c3: You can now edit time entries! Tap on them!
1290.c4: Many improvements have been made to clarity of how to add, update, and delete various items across WitnessWork. Hints have been removed as they're no longer necessary.
1290.c5: I'm looking for 2 volunteers who have experience in Software QA to assist in testing releases before they reach the public. If you have interest in spending a few hours a month testing, your support would be greatly appreciated. Please contact me: levi@leviwilkerson.com. In the future and as expenses allows, a portion of donations will go to QA for their time.
1290.c6: Annual time overview screen now is compressed for better readability.

1291.c1: [ANDROID] Resolved crashes that occurred when editing time.

1300.c1: Add 'Annual Schedule' to Plan Schedule screen for those with an annual goal, allowing you to easily see if you have planned enough time for your entire service year.
1300.c2: Hides 'today' schedule view when the month is in the future because it's not applicable.
1300.c4: If a contact pin was dragged for a contact, navigation will now prioritize the manually adjusted pin over their address. Editing a contact's address will return the address to priority.
1300.c7: Contact pin colors on Contact Details Screen now matches the map screen.
1300.c9: Month and annual total calculations now properly limit your credit time to 55 hours per month. Standard time is not affected by this rule. If you exceed this time using credit, you'll have overage displayed on your month's details screen.
1300.c10: Added time credit support. Existing users will be able to update their old time entries automatically.
1300.c11: Resolved issue with add button overlapping compass on iOS.

1310.c1: Greatly improved performance when navigating to time related screens.
1310.c3: Resolve date localization issue that occurred in some regions.
1310.c4: Updated styles and locations of commonly used items. Month and Service Year reports can be easily accessed in the tab bar at the bottom of the screen.
1310.c5: Resolved style overflow issues that occurred on certain screen sizes for the map screen.
1310.c6: Now automatically prefills recently used addresses when creating multiple contacts on the same day.
1310.c7: You can now toggle visibility of the home screen sections. Visit Preferences > Home Screen.
1310.c8: The app now is named WitnessWork, formerly 'JW Time' due to legal reasons.
1310.c9: Languages now attempt to find your exact region, otherwise it falls back to any locale with your language. If nothing can be found, it defaults to English.
1310.c10: Bemba language added! We need your help to translate. Please visit Settings > Help Translate

1320.c1: Now create coordinate only contacts. If your territory is very rural or with bad mapping information, there is now no need to rely on an address.
1320.c2: Easily toggle between device, dark, and light mode color scheme. Visit Preferences > Appearance.
1320.c4: 'Add Time' screen now allows for increments of 1 minute.
1320.c5: Wongeyeho ururimi rwa Kinyarwanda, rwahinduwe byuzuye na Semana D. Urakoze cyane kubufasha bwawe!
1320.c6: Urashobora noneho guhitamo uburyo igihe cyawe cyerekanwa. Hitamo hagati ya cumi nka: 13.5 cyangwa uhitemo 13 Hrs 30 Mins. Sura Ibyifuzo & gt; Kugaragara.

1330.c1: Hongewemo gutoranya ururimi. Reba Ibyatoranijwe kugirango uhindure ururimi.
1330.c2: Ikibazo cyakemutse kuri gahunda y'umusi umwe ifite itariki ntarengwa.

1340.c1: Wongeyeho ibihembo bidasanzwe mugihe ugenzuye igihe cyawe cyangwa wongeyeho umwanya!
1340.c2: Urashobora noneho gushiraho agaciro ka cumi kumigambi yisaha kuri & apos; gakondo & apos; ubwoko bw'abamamaza.

1350.c1: Urashobora noneho gukoresha autocomplete kugirango ushakishe adresse! Gusa tangira wandika kugirango ubone ibyifuzo. Iyi ngingo irashoboka gusa nimpano zawe nyinshi. Urakoze ku nkunga yawe!
1350.c2: Ikibazo cyakemutse aho urupapuro rwumunsi rudafunga byikora mugihe wongeyeho umwanya kumunsi wukwezi.
1350.c3: Gukemura ikibazo cyuzuye hejuru murugo murugo rwa tableti.

1360.c1: New: Share Contacts and easily import them. Transfering calls is now easier than ever.
1360.c2: Added a color key to the map view! You can now customize the colors of the pins on the map.
1360.c3: NEW: Dismiss Contact feature - You can now dismiss contacts you no longer wish to visit and receive notifications when it's time to return to them.
1360.c4: Added notes support to time reports - You can now add notes to your daily time entries to keep track of important details.
1360.c5: Improves visibility of Map on Contacts Details screen.
1360.c7: Added statistics sections to your Monthly and Yearly reports to better track your progress and patterns.
1360.c8: You can now change your calendar's first day of the week. Visit Preferences > Appearance.
1360.c9: Improved progress bar animations throughout the app and added additional encouragement messages.
1360.c10: Enhanced follow up topic input - Now supports multiple lines for easier writing of longer topics.
1360.c11: There are now no restrictions on when you can add or schedule time, in the future or past.
1360.c12: Added visual indicators on calendar days to show when notes are present.
1360.c13: Resolves issue with Korean and Panama phone number formatting.
1360.c14: Improves visibility of Map on Contacts Details screen with better zoom levels.
1360.c15: Fixed various navigation issues when adding time and scheduling plans.
1360.c16: Improved readability and consistency throughout the app with better spacing and button sizes.

1382.c1: The Milestone Update is here. Isura nshya yose hamwe na bar ya tab ireremba, amakarita akonje, hamwe nuburyo bushya, bugezweho muri porogaramu.
1382.c2: New Contacts tab with fuzzy search, smart sort, and stacked filters. Your contacts are now a first-class destination.
1382.c3: Progress Screen 2.0: isura nshya y'ukwezi, umwaka, n'ibihe byose, hamwe n'ibihe by'ingenzi bigezweho, gusenyuka kw'ibyiciro, n'amasaha y'ubuzima.
1382.c4: iCloud sync arrives (Supporter): your reports, contacts, and plans stay in step across all your devices. Optional photo sync keeps avatars synced too.
1382.c5: Onboarding has been rebuilt from the ground up. Ibaruramari ryihariye ryububiko bwibicuruzwa, igenamigambi ryihariye, hamwe nuburyo bwo kugenzura ibicuruzwa byawe.
1382.c6: Brand new home screen widgets: monthly calendar, appointments, hours, and contacts. All one tap away.
1382.c7: Contact avatars are here. Amafoto cyangwa emoji, hamwe na tap-to-kwagura fullscreen viewer.
1382.c8: Sangira contact n'undi mwanditsi ukoresheje secure universal links.
1382.c9: Smarter repeating plans. Schedule by day-of-week and week-of-month, with per-instance overrides and deletions.
1382.c10: Time rollover: Fractional minutes carry forward into next month, manually or automatically.
1382.c11: Beautiful new celebrations the moment you cross a goal.
1382.c12: New Supporter tier with personalization, including a custom accent color.
1382.c13: Schedule screen: a focused calendar view of day plans and repeating conversations.
1382.c14: Ikarita y'umwirondoro ivuguruye kuri ecran yo mu rugo yerekana uruhare rwawe, igihe cyakorewe, n'imibare ishimishije.
1382.c15: Ibiganiro byihariye n'ibyabuze ubu bigaragaramo kuri ecran yo mu rugo kugira ngo utazigera utakaza icyerekezo.
1382.c16: Telephone region code now persists across new contacts. Porogaramu yo kugenzura ibicuruzwa bya elegitoroniki byihuse kandi byihuse.
1382.c17: Map empty state, location prompts, and contact map clustering have all been polished.
1382.c18: Ibicuruzwa bito bitabarika, impinduka mu mikorere, no kunoza amashusho muri porogaramu.

1383.c1: Gahunda ubu zigira ikiciro. Shyira ikiciro kuri gahunda wateganyije maze igiteranyo giteganyijwe kigaragaze ubwoko bwa credit bukwiriye.
1383.c2: Igiteranyo giteganyijwe ubu ni cyo cyukuri. Cyubahiriza urugero rwa credit rwawe rwa buri kwezi kandi ntikibarira inshuro ebyiri igihe wamaze kwandika uyu munsi.
1383.c3: Ijwi ryo kwishima ubu ryubahiriza buto yo kuvuza cyangwa guceceka ya telefoni yawe.
1383.c5: Aderesi nshya n'impinduka ku makuru y'aho atuye ubu bibikwa ako kanya, ndetse na mbere y'uko ikarita irangiza kubona aho biherereye.
1383.c6: Kalendari yihuza n'igihe ako kanya numara kongeraho, guhindura, cyangwa kuvanaho gahunda.
1383.c7: Pin zo ku ikarita ziguma zigaragara nyuma yo kuzikandaho.
1383.c8: Kugenda hejuru na hasi kuworoshye ku rutonde rw'Aderesi.
1383.c4: Impano watanze ubu zigaragaza neza igihe cyo kwishyura n'igiciro by'umufasha wiyandikishije buri mwaka cyangwa wahawe.

1400.c1: Switching from MyTime? You can now import your contacts and visit history straight from a MyTime backup, with a preview before anything is added, so there's no manual re-entry.
1400.c2: Date format, clock style, and start of the week are now separate from your app language. Set each one in Settings > Date & Time, with an Auto option that follows your region or device.
1400.c3: You can now customize the day thresholds and colors behind contact staleness. Tune them in Settings > Personalization > Color Key.
1400.c4: The map search box keeps focus while you type, so filtering contacts no longer interrupts you.
1400.c5: Locating contacts on the map now shows live progress, and you can skip it midway without losing your place.
1400.c6: Faster, smoother scrolling in the Contacts list, plus quicker home screen widget updates.
1400.c7: Fixed projected totals around time zone changes, enlarged header buttons for easier tapping, and polished countless small details throughout the app.

1411.c1: Gishya: Menya Scribe AI. Omekaho inyandiko zawe z'umurimo wo kubwiriza, zaba zanditse nk'inyandiko y'intoki cyangwa amakuru yoherejwe n'indi porogaramu, maze Scribe AI izihindure aderesi, gusura n'ibyanditswe by'igihe kugira ngo ubanze ubisuzume mbere yo kubika. Ushobora kunoza ibyavuyemo ubiganiraho ako kanya, gutangira kwinjiza amakuru mu itangira rya porogaramu, kandi nta Nguzanyo yo Kwinjiza uzatakaza igihe nta makuru yabonetse.
1411.c2: Hongewe ahantu hashya h'Uku Kwezi kuri ecran y'ibanze ushobora guhindura. Intego, igiteranyo giteganyijwe n'umuvuduko wa gahunda byawe biri ku makarita ushobora gutondeka no kwagura, naho Raporo y'Umurimo ikaguma ku ikarita imwe itondetse neza. Kanda raporo kugira ngo urebe ibisobanuro byose.
1411.c3: Hindura intego y'ukwezi kumwe. Shyiraho intego itandukanye y'ukwezi kumwe igihe imimerere yawe ihindutse, kandi urebe amasaha wateganyije ku ruziga rwayo rw'iterambere.
1411.c4: Teganya ibintu birenze kimwe ku munsi. Gahunda z'umunsi zo ku itariki imwe ubu zirateranywa, buri imwe igakomeza kugira icyiciro cyayo, kandi gahunda zitabarwa kuri uwo munsi zigaragazwa neza.
1411.c5: Guhindura ibintu byaroroshye hose. Gahunda, ibyanditswe by'igihe n'ibiganiro ubu bifite akamenyetso k'utudomo dutatu karimo Guhindura no Gusiba; gahunda zisubirwamo na zo zitanga amahitamo asobanutse yo guhindura itariki imwe, amatariki azaza cyangwa gahunda yose.
1411.c6: Raporo z'Umurimo: Kongera gutanga raporo ukoresheje Hourglass na NW Publisher birahari, ushobora guhitamo uburyo busanzwe bwo kuyitanga, guhindura ibisobanuro bya raporo mbere yo kuyohereza no kubona urwibutso ku mpera z'ukwezi. Ubu ushobora no kugabanya amateka y'imyaka cyangwa kongeramo imyaka yabanje.
1411.c7: Gahunda ubu igaragaza uko buri munsi uhagaze mu kanya gato: uri imbere, uri inyuma, uri ku murongo, uraza, urahuye cyangwa nta gahunda ihari.
1411.c8: Ubu kuba Umufasha bikurikira Apple ID yawe ku bikoresho byose, umubare w'ibyo Scribe AI yemera kwimurirwa ku yindi gahunda, kandi ecran y'Umufasha yarorohejwe.
1411.c9: Hakosowe ibyanditswe by'igihe na gahunda byajyaga ku munsi utari wo mu turere tw'isaha twa UTC+12 no hejuru yaho, hamwe n'amatariki yajyaga ku munsi utari wo nijoro mu burengerazuba bwa UTC. Hakosowe n'udushusho two ku ikarita twafunguraga aderesi itari yo nyuma yo kunyereza amakarita. Ubu kwimurira igihe mu kwezi gukurikira bisiga Igihe cy'Inguzanyo mu kwezi kwacyo.
1411.c10: Akamenyetso k'Inguzanyo ku byiciro ubu karaboneka ku Mubwiriza wese wandika amasaha. Hakosowe kandi ikibazo kidasanzwe cyafungaga porogaramu igihe ufunze igikoresho cyo guhitamo, hagarurwa inyenyeri z'abo ukunda n'ikimenyetso cy'icyigisho cya Bibiliya cy'ukwezi turimo, havugururwa Expo SDK 57, kandi ingano ya porogaramu iragabanywa.

1420.c1: Imiterere mishya ya iPad yerekana abantu, amakarita na gahunda iruhande rw’amakuru arambuye yabyo.
1420.c2: Hindura imyanya y’amakuru y’abantu: hindura uko telefoni, imeyili n’imyanya yihariye bikurikirana, uhishe telefoni cyangwa imeyili, kandi usibe burundu imyanya yihariye yashyizwe mu bubiko.
1420.c3: Reba igihe wanditse ukurikije ibyiciro mu mwaka w’umurimo wose, kandi uhindure umubare ntarengwa w’amasaha yemewe y’indi mirimo buri kwezi mu mahitamo y’ibyiciro by’ababwiriza bibyemera.
1420.c4: Raporo zoherezwa muri Hourglass ubu zitandukanya igihe cyo kubwiriza n’amasaha yemewe y’indi mirimo.
1420.c5: Umufasha wa kalendari yongeye kuboneka, kandi ushobora kumugena mu mahitamo ya Gahunda.

1430.c1: Uburyo bwo kurinda amakuru ku babwiriza bo mu Bumwe bw'u Burayi, mu Bwongereza no mu Busuwisi bubika amakuru ya ba nyir'inzu mu rugero itegeko ryemera, harimo gukurikirana uruhushya rwabo no gusiba aderesi umaze igihe udasura.
1430.c2: Ongeraho aderesi uhereye ku kamenyetso ushyize ku ikarita.
1430.c3: Ababwiriza b'Ubwami bashobora guhitamo kwandika amasaha yabo bakoresheje kubara igihe, intego y'ukwezi itari ngombwa n'igice cy'Iterambere.
1430.c4: Igice cy'Umwaka ubu kigaragaza igiteranyo cy'umwaka w'umurimo ku cyiciro cy'ababwiriza cyose, niyo nta ntego y'umwaka yaba ihari.
1430.c5: Guteganya gusubira gusura ubu ntibikiri ngombwa, kandi ushobora kuzimya amajwi ya porogaramu mu Mahitamo.
1430.c6: Hakosowe amatariki yahindukaga ku babwiriza bari mu turere tw'isaha two mu Burasirazuba bwa Kure.

1440.c1: Kugenda byoroshye hamwe n'utubuto enye twanditseho ushobora gutondeka. Ikarita ubu iri hejuru ya Abantu, naho Igenamiterere riri munsi y'ifoto yawe.
1440.c2: Abantu bongeye gutegurwa ku bijyanye n'ibikurikira, na buri gusura biri ku murongo w'igihe. Andika gusura ukoresheje menu ya +, ubone ibitekerezo by'abari hafi, kandi wongere imyanya yihariye mu biganiro.
1440.c3: Ingengabihe ifite kalendari y'umwaka n'ukwezi ushobora kwagura, kandi gahunda ishobora kuba amasaha gusa cyangwa igihe cyuzuye.
1440.c4: Reba umuvuduko w'umwaka wawe w'umurimo ukwezi ku kwezi, kandi wishimire urukurikirane n'ibimenyetso ku nzira.
1440.c5: Kurikirana ibirometero ni ubushake, kandi byandika ingendo zawe n'ikiguzi cya lisansi.
1440.c6: Gusubirayo bishobora guhuzwa na kalendari yagenewe WitnessWork gusa, ubu no kuri Android, aho ushobora no kubika no guhuza ukoresheje Google Drive.
1440.c7: Inyibutsa zitegereza mu nzogera y'amamenyesha aho kwirundanya ku Ahabanza.

1450.c1: Menya Scribe AI: vuga cyangwa wandike amakuru, maze yandike igihe cyawe, itegure iminsi yawe, yongereho abantu kandi yandike gusura. Nta kintu kibikwa mbere y'uko ukanda Ongeraho.
1450.c2: Tora inyamaswa y'inshuti ku Ahabanza. Ikomeza kwishima igihe ukomeje kujya mu murimo wo kubwiriza, kandi ikuguhera ibintu byo mu cyumba, ingofero n'ibitunguranye by'ibanga uko ugenda.
1450.c3: Ekara nshya ya Konti ibika amakuru yawe kuri WitnessWork hakoreshejwe ibanga rivanwaho gusa n'ubifitiye uburenganzira, igaha urufunguzo rwo kugarura, kandi ikagufasha gushyiraho ikindi gikoresho ukoresheje QR code.
1450.c4: Abafasha bashobora guhuza amakuru hagati ya iPhone na Android binyuze kuri Cloud Sync ifite ibanga, kandi bagategura inzira y'umunsi ifite aho bagomba guhagarara hakurikijwe uko biri byiza.
1450.c5: Funga porogaramu ukoresheje isura yawe, igikumwe cyangwa kode y'ibanga.
1450.c6: WitnessWork ubu iboneka mu Cyarabu, ifite imiterere isomwa uhereye iburyo ujya ibumoso.
1450.c7: Hindura amakarita yo ku Ahabanza no kuri Iterambere, shyira imiterere ku nyandiko kandi wongereho amafoto, shungura abantu ukurikije gusubirayo, kandi urebe igihe raporo y'ukwezi kose yoherejwe.
1450.c8: Gushyigikira neza inyuguti nini, porogaramu zisoma ekara, inyuguti zibyibushye no gutandukanya amabara cyane.

1460.c1: Ubu itungo ryawe ribona ibiceri bya zahabu buri munsi ugiye mu murimo wo kubwiriza. Bikoreshe mu Iduka rishya ugura ingofero n'ibintu byo mu cyumba, kandi ubone ibyo utunze byose mu Kabati karyo.
1460.c2: Kanda ku rukurikirane rwawe ku Ahabanza urebe igihe rwatangiriye n'agahigo kawe kugeza ubu.
1460.c3: Ushobora kuzimya Scribe AI mu Igenamiterere, kandi igusaba kubyemera mbere y'uko uyikoresha bwa mbere.

Ifoto yawe, ubupayiniya, urukurikirane, ibimenyetso, inyamaswa n'amasaha yo gutangira bisangizwa keretse ubizimije. iCloudImagesEnableConfirm_description:
Ifoto y'umwirondoro wawe, amafoto y'abantu wongeyeho n'amafoto yo mu nyandiko zawe azakopororerwa muri iCloud Drive yawe. Azahuzwa n'ibindi bikoresho byawe kandi abarwe mu bubiko bwawe bwa iCloud — amafoto y'umwirondoro n'ay'abantu yaciwe niyo yoherezwa; amafoto y'umwimerere ataciwe agume ku gikoresho wayahiriyeho.

Kugira ngo ibanga rirusheho kurindwa, turakugira inama yo gufungura Advanced Data Protection ya iCloud (Igenamiterere → [Izina ryawe] → iCloud → Advanced Data Protection) kugira ngo amafoto abe arinzwe n'ibanga kuva ku ikorwa kugeza ku isomwa kandi ibikoresho byawe byonyine bibe bifite imfunguzo.

serviceYearPace.title: Umuvuduko w'umwaka w'umurimo
serviceYearPace.info: Umurongo w'imvi ucagaguye ni aho Intego yawe y'umwaka ikugeza mu mpera za buri kwezi, wubakwa ku ntego ya buri kwezi ubwayo. Umurongo w'icyatsi ni igihe cyawe kugeza ubu, nyuma y'imbibi z'inyongera za buri kwezi, naho umurongo w'icyatsi ucagaguye wongeraho gahunda zawe. Umurongo urabagirana gato ni umwaka w'umurimo ushize, iyo wawanditsemo igihe, ufite igiteranyo cyawo ku mpera. Ibiteranyo biri hejuru cyane y'intego yawe bishushanywa ku gipimo gifunze kugira ngo igice gisigaye cy'umwaka gikomeze gusomeka. Kanda ufate ku ikarita kugira ngo urebe ukwezi kose.

Niba ufunguye guhuza kwa iCloud, inyandiko zawe zibikwa muri iCloud kandi zigahuzwa ku bikoresho byawe. contactDetails.historyInfo: Igishushanyo cyerekana amezi atandatu ashize. Akadomo kuzuye ni icyigisho cya Bibiliya, akadomo gafite umurongo gusa ni ikiganiro, naho kare bivuze ko nta wari mu rugo. Umurongo wijimye werekana uyu munsi, naho umurongo w'utudomo werekeza ku gusubirayo gukurikira. Hasi, buri gusura kugaragaza niba gusubirayo kwakurikijwe, kwasibye cyangwa kwakuweho.

Hitamo Cloud Sync kugira ngo uhuze iPhone na Android hamwe, irinzwe n'ibanga impande zombi, cyangwa iCloud kugira ngo uhuze iPhone na iPad ukoresheje Apple Account yawe.
syncSettings_descriptionAndroid: Guhuza bituma inyandiko zawe z'umurimo, abantu, gusura, gahunda n'amahitamo biba bimwe ku bikoresho byawe. WitnessWork ntirinda guhuza kwa iCloud n'ibanga impande zombi. Amakuru yawe ari kuri iki gikoresho arabikwa kandi agahuzwa n'ibindi bikoresho byawe biri kuri Cloud Sync.

scribe_zdrNoTrainingBody: Scribe AI ikoresha gusa abatanga serivisi z'ubwenge bw'ubukorano bemera, mu masezerano, kutagira amakuru yawe babika no kutayakoresha mu gutoza AI.
scribe_zdrOnDeviceBody: Ibiganiro byawe n'ibyibutswe na Scribe AI bibikwa kuri iki gikoresho gusa. Iyo uvuze, ijwi ryawe rihindurwa inyandiko kuri iki gikoresho, kandi amajwi ntabikwa.
scribe_zdrInControlBody: Scribe AI itanga ibitekerezo by'impinduka gusa. Nta kintu cyongerwaho kugeza ukanze Ongeraho, kandi ushobora kuzimya Scribe AI mu Igenamiterere igihe cyose.
scribe_zdrPolicyLink: Soma politiki ya OpenRouter yo kutabika amakuru
scribe_termsPrivateBody: Scribe AI ikoresha gusa ibyo wohereje kugira ngo itegure amakuru yawe mashya. Ntibibikwa, kandi ntibikoreshwa na rimwe mu gutoza AI.
scribe_termsMistakesBody: AI ishobora kwibeshya. Suzuma buri mpinduka mbere yo kuyongeraho.
scribe_termsBody: Ukanze Ndemera, uba wemeye Amabwiriza yo Gukoresha na Politiki y'Ibanga bya WitnessWork.
scribe_memoryInfoBody: Iyo ukosoye Scribe AI, ukoresheje amagambo yawe ku kintu, cyangwa ukayisaba kwibuka, ibika inyandiko ngufi hano, kandi isoma izo nyandiko mu ntangiriro ya buri kiganiro. Ushobora kuzihindura cyangwa wongeremo izawe; impinduka zitangira gukora mu kiganiro gikurikira. Ziguma kuri iki gikoresho.
scribe_memoryPlaceholder: Nta kintu kugeza ubu. Kosora Scribe AI cyangwa uvuge uti “Ibuka…” maze ibike inyandiko hano.
scribe_memoryOffNote: Scribe AI ntisoma cyangwa ngo ibike izi nyandiko igihe kwibuka kuzimye.
scribe_memoryClearConfirm: Gusiba inyandiko zose? Scribe AI izibagirwa mu biganiro bishya.
scribe_usageInfoBody: Ikoreshwa rishingira ku bwinshi bw'ibyo Scribe AI isoma n'ibyo yandika, atari ku bwinshi bw'ubutumwa wohereza. Ivugurura ryihuse rikoresha bike; ibiganiro birebire n'impapuro bikoresha byinshi. Buri rugero rutangira ukoresheje bwa mbere kandi rusubira bundi bushya ku gihe cyerekanwe.
scribe_usageStale: Ntibyashobotse kugenzura ikoreshwa rishya. Ibi ni ibyo Scribe AI yatangaje bwa nyuma.
scribe_usageSupporterCheckFailed: Ntibyashobotse kugenzura imimerere yawe y'Umufasha, bityo imipaka y'ubuntu ni yo ikoreshwa ubu.

scribe_limitUpsell: Abafasha babona imipaka minini cyane yongera gutangira buri masaha make.
